post.description: Requires canCreateFinancialAdjustment (financial_adjustment/create), canCreateJournal (journal/create) AND canUpdateFinancialActivity (financial_activity/update). Only OUTSTANDING, not-yet-reversed journals can be corrected. RECONCILED journals return 409 and are final. Full reversal only; no amount parameter. Initial-payment, void, inventory-source, loan-linked and reversal entries require dedicated correction workflows. One adjustment per original journal in the tenant; requestId (8-100 characters) is audit metadata, not the deduplication key. Same original and exact reason returns the existing adjustment with 201 even with another requestId; changed reason returns 409. No TTL is configured. Original period remains immutable.

Requires journal create, pickup view and assigned or full invoice creation. Validates current assignment and linked customer fields in the financial transaction. Exact UUID/body/pickup retries cannot duplicate the payment or automatic number. Creates the same pending invoice/daily income records as the existing web financial workflow. Does not settle a payment merely because the client stored it offline.
post.summary: Synchronize an assigned pickup initial payment

post.description: Requires journal create permission. Commits a user/tenant UUID receipt with existing journal posting and pending-invoice/financial effects. Retry the same UUID and recognized payload. Changed payload or deleted result returns 409 without posting again. Entry must omit idempotencyKey. Current permissions and existing financial rules still apply. Body limit 3 MiB; receipts are not automatically expired.

Requires journal view. Supply filters using the journal search allowlist OR 1–200 distinct IDs, never both. MongoDB aggregation, no pagination. Income: INITIAL-PAYMENT, PAYMENT, SALES and INVENTORY dispatched. Expenses: EXPENSE account debits, otherwise EXPENSE or INVENTORY received amount. Other types count but do not contribute income. Net is income minus expenses, never converted.

Requires explicit canReconcileJournal. Accepts 1–200 distinct journal ObjectIDs with one payment method. All must be Outstanding, not reversed, and in the current company. Atomic accounting approval and audit; never changes invoice payments or balances; UUID requestId is durable and payload-bound. Reconciled is final.

post.description: Records a balanced double-entry journal. Receipt/refund entries require paymentMethod.name: CASH posts to CASH ON HAND; ZELLE and DEPOSIT require a BANK paymentAccount; CHECK posts to CHECKS TO DEPOSIT unless a BANK paymentAccount is supplied; CREDIT-CARD posts to CARD PROCESSOR RECEIVABLE. PAYMENT and INITIAL-PAYMENT accept account as a backward-compatible Zelle/deposit destination alias. ZELLE, DEPOSIT, CHECK and CREDIT-CARD invoice receipts create outstanding directory records; invoice payment and balance change immediately on creation, independently of reconciliation. Server recording time and the authenticated user location select the latest closeout. It must be open and dated today in that location timezone; otherwise returns 409 CLOSEOUT_REQUIRED with reason NONE_EXISTS, STALE_OPEN_CLOSEOUT, or LATEST_CLOSED plus date/timezone metadata. This operation never opens or closes closeouts. When neither an employee nor daily route is selected, employee defaults to the creator linked employee. INITIAL-PAYMENT without invoice.id creates a PENDING invoice and accepts either employee or vehicleRoute/route/employeeGroup assignees, including zero-amount registrations. Employee financial responsibility is independent of route attribution; route-attributed finances belong to the captured supervisor. Response data is PostEntryResult with current statement totals. Optional autoClear (default false) reconciles every valid transaction type/payment method, including cash, and requires explicit canReconcileJournal. Otherwise the journal is OUTSTANDING. ReconciledAt is API approval time, independent of journal date. Journal PUT cannot change reconciliation fields. Later approval uses POST /journals/reconcile; method-directory clearing is retired.

409.description: Closeout required, duplicate invoice or duplicate payment conflict

INITIAL-PAYMENT and VOID entries are managed through the invoice lifecycle and cannot be updated here. Requires journal update permission.
Posted journals are immutable. Use the dedicated reversing-adjustment endpoint with financial_adjustment create permission.

Removes the journal document. Running totals are calculated dynamically, so nothing is recalculated; the only exception is an invoice-payment entry, where the invoice's stored total is updated to remove the deleted entry's effect. Deleting INITIAL-PAYMENT also removes the linked PENDING invoice stub when it has not been completed. VOID entries cannot be deleted here. Requires journal delete permission.
